dogecoin.text: Such rubbish. @novogratz says there's "something pure about what @dogecoin has done". Is he angling for a dinner invite from @elonmusk? Oh wait .. he's on the board at @SpaceX. There's nothing pure or good about this BS. Some people will be burned. https://t.co/m2fvTTaIrc #GrowUp

It takes little more than half a brain to know $DOGE come tumbling down spectacularly sooner or later. But it's a bit heartless to laugh knowingly at thousands of clueless retail investors being wrecked by this. Why is there still so much immaturity in this #cryptocurrency space?
